components.label: Description
components.quote: NUVAXOVID (COVID-19 Vaccine, Adjuvanted) is a colorless to slightly yellow, clear to mildly opalescent sterile suspension for intramuscular use that is free from visible particles.

components.label: Description
components.quote: Each 0.5 mL dose of NUVAXOVID (2026-2027 Formula) contains 5 mcg of recombinant spike glycoprotein (rS) of the SARS-CoV-2 JN.1-descendent variant XFG and 50 mcg Matrix-M adjuvant. The Matrix-M adjuvant is composed of Fraction-A (42.5 mcg) and Fraction-C (7.5 mcg) of saponin extracts from the soapbark tree, Quillaja saponaria Molina.

components.label: Description
components.quote: The rS protein is produced by recombinant DNA technology using a baculovirus expression system in the Sf9 insect cell line that is derived from the Spodoptera frugiperda species.

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote: Do not administer NUVAXOVID to individuals with a known history of severe allergic reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) to any component of NUVAXOVID [see Description (11)] or to individuals who had a severe allergic reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) following a previous dose of Novavax COVID-19 Vaccine, Adjuvanted.

dismissed.egg: 全文掃描『embryo』2 個命中皆為 p.31 8.1 Pregnancy 段落標題『Disease-Associated Maternal and/or Embryo/Fetal Risk』，與雞蛋成分無關
dismissed.other_antibiotics: 全文掃描『antibiotic』2 個命中皆為 p.18 ADVERSE REACTIONS 不良反應敘述（蜂窩性組織炎經抗生素與類固醇治療後緩解），非本疫苗成分
dismissed.aluminium: 全文掃描『adjuvant』121 個命中：本品全名為『NUVAXOVID (COVID-19 Vaccine, Adjuvanted)』，全文反覆出現的是產品名稱與『Matrix-M adjuvant』（皂樹皂苷佐劑），與鋁鹽佐劑無關，已於本格 related 附 p.32 Matrix-M 成分原句
